==Dialogue==
:'''Althea:''' Nue, you're from... Ashinohara, right?
:'''Althea:''' I heard that card dueling games have been popular there for a long time.
:'''Nue:''' That's right. Before I came to the Academy, it was the go-to activity between classes.
:'''Althea:''' So that missing girl... Chisa. She's probably really good at this too, huh?
:'''Nue:''' You know what... it could be? Honami City is a major hub after all...
:'''Nue:''' I'll ask her about it next time I see her.
{{Dialogue End}}
